blocks.text: Tetracycline aik antibiotic hai jo mitti mein rehne wale genus Streptomyces ke bacteria se hasil hoti hai. Yeh bacteriostatic (bacteria ki growth rokne wali) dawa hai jo munh se li jati hai (oral) aur chlamydia aur syphilis jaise bacterial infections mein istemal hoti hai. Yeh bacteria mein protein banne (protein synthesis) ko rokti hai. Ise doodh ki cheezon (dairy) ya iron supplements ke saath nahi lena chahiye. Aam side effects matli, ulti, dast aur dhoop se hassasiyat (sun sensitivity) hain.

items: Bacteriostatic asar: yeh bacteria ko seedha maarne ke bajaye un ki growth aur afzaish rok deti hai.
Gram-negative/positive par asar: yeh Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono qisam ke bacteria ke khilaf kaam karti hai.
Ribosomes ko nishana banana: tetracycline bacterial cell mein dakhil ho kar 30S ribosomal subunit se waqti taur par (reversibly) jurti hai.
Protein banna rokna: 30S ribosome se jur kar yeh aminoacyl-tRNA (amino acid laane wala tRNA) ko acceptor (A) site par jurne nahi deti, is liye translation aur protein synthesis ruk jate hain.

blocks.text: Doodh ki cheezon mein calcium aur supplements mein iron hota hai; yeh tetracycline se jur kar us ka jazb hona kam kar dete hain, is liye dawa kam asar karti hai.
blocks.title: Asaan alfaaz mein

blocks.prompt: Tetracycline kis ribosomal subunit se jurti hai aur kya rokti hai?
blocks.explanation: 30S subunit se; yeh aminoacyl-tRNA ko A site par aane se rok kar translation (protein banna) band karti hai.

items: Tetracycline: Streptomyces se; bacteriostatic; Gram-positive aur Gram-negative dono par.
30S subunit se jur kar A site par aminoacyl-tRNA rokti hai; dairy ya iron ke saath nahi.
